POWER MECHANICS — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Careers in Power Mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Careers in Power Mechanics.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Careers in Power Mechanics.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Careers in Power Mechanics.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Careers in Power Mechanics.

2. When learning Surface Developmen t of prisms, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Surface Developmen t of prisms.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Developmen t of prisms.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Surface Developmen t of prisms.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Surface Developmen t of prisms.

3. When learning electronic systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for electronic systems.

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Speaker
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

6. When learning Motor Vehicle batteries, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle batteries.

7. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester

8. When learning Assembly drawing and Sectioning, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly drawing and Sectioning.

   D. Skip safety briefings for Assembly drawing and Sectioning.

9. When learning Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.

   D. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.

11. When learning Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 Oxy acetylene welding in motor vehicles 4. Engi.

12. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool

13. When learning Introduction to computer aided drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

15. When learning Management of Road Transport, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Management of Road Transport.

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Management of Road Transport.

16. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to computer aided drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Oxy-acetylene welding in motor vehicles and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
